title: [GMCP 203.004.M] Mastery: Legacy lifecycle compatibility and governed deprecation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-004-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP interoperates with pinned older MCP revisions through isolated compatibility adapters for initialize/initialized, ping, legacy HTTP+SSE, resource subscriptions, roots, sampling, elicitation, logging, and legacy task shapes without weakening the modern path. Version selection is deterministic, downgrade is visible, every deprecated feature has telemetry and a tested removal policy, and no legacy state crosses tenant or connection boundaries. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
